name: BMR Concrete Finishing Robot 80SZ
summary: Battery power trowel that maps the slab with SLAM and floats, trowels and polishes fresh concrete on its own at 300 m²/h or more, with remote control as an option.

germany.statusNote: No authorised route to Germany found. BMR sells direct from China and names markets in Asia, the Middle East and Brazil, none in the EU. The only German listing is a US reseller not named by BMR, and BMR states no CE marking for this machine. Roboter Deutschland, a web shop run from Las Vegas without a named company, also lists it; it is not counted as a seller here.
germany.leadTime: 6-8 weeks (reseller claim, not confirmed by BMR)

sellers.name: Shenzhen BrightMaster Robotics Co., Ltd.
sellers.note: Direct export enquiries via form, email or WhatsApp from Shenzhen; no EU office or EU distributor named.

specs.label: Operating modes
specs.value: fully automatic (SLAM mapping and navigation) or remote control

notes: Rests and moves on its rotating trowel blades like a ride-on power trowel; no wheels (product image).
Works fresh cast-in-place concrete: compaction, slurry lifting, finishing and polishing.
Operating temperature 0-45 °C; no IP rating stated.
